name: Gazel Tana
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Hobby: Napping, Sword Training
Special Skill: Falling asleep in an instant
Likes: Animals
Dislikes: Swimming, Things to do with water
Treasure: His Wooden Sword

A knight apprentice along with [url=/c45872]Sylphis[/url]. An energetic boy.
He's very emotional and a little overconfident.
He used to be the leader of a gang of kids around the town and is still good friends with them.
He really admires his instructor [url=/c45888]Leonis[/url].
